name: H16, H17, H18, H26 - User can be block/unblocked

steps.name: Create two accounts, dismiss download alerts and go to Friends
First user grants clipboard permissions, Copy DID and save it into a constant
Add first user as a friend
locator.getByText('Your request is making it\'s way!').waitFor
With First User, go to requests list and accept friend request
With Second User, go to All Friends
H16 - Clicking block should block user
H17 - User should be displayed under Blocked Users after you block them
H18 - User should be cleared from Blocked Users after you unblock them
H26 - User can unblock a user and add again the same user
locator.getByText('Your request is making it\'s way!').waitFor
Accept incoming request after being unblocked
Send message to another user after being unblocked
Validate messages from unblocked user care received
